start_on.label: Start in first person
start_on.description: Whether each player starts a session in first person. H switches, for whoever presses it.

fov.label: Field of view
fov.description: Degrees. The game's own first-person view uses 75.

eye_height.label: Eye height
eye_height.description: Metres above the head's collision point.

eye_forward.label: Eye forward
eye_forward.description: Metres in front of the head, so the view clears the face.

pitch_limit.label: Look up and down
pitch_limit.description: How far up or down you can look, in degrees.

face_camera.label: Hero faces the view
face_camera.description: Turns the hero to where you look, so swings and spells go there.

third_person_aim.label: Third-person gun aim
third_person_aim.description: Aiming a gun or crossbow uses the game's over-the-shoulder camera.

scenes.label: First person in conversations
scenes.description: Stay in first person when talking and in interactive scenes, facing the speaker. Full cutscenes keep their own camera.
